newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SNB leaves discount rate at 1.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: SNB leaves discount rate at 1.00 pct.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank (SNB) said it left its discount rate unchanged at 1.00 percent after a regular weekly meeting of its three-member board.
"Nothing has changed. No change," an SNB spokesman said in response to an enquiry.
The discount rate was last changed when it was lowered to 1.00 percent from 1.50 percent on September 26, 1996.
The rate currently matches the historic low maintained from February 1978 to November 1979.
